_readme: Copy to pick-proj-rule.json to ARM the projected grade on GEX Change Top picks.
While pick-proj-rule.json is absent (the shipping default) no projection is
made, no proj_grade is stamped, and no Proj pill renders. That is deliberate.
Build `terms` from the Pick Study tab (/scanner?tab=pickstudy): take only
buckets that are NOT marked thin and that show a green check in the Holds
column, hit the tiny 'term' button on each row, and paste the results here.
A bucket that does not hold in both halves of the window is not a finding.
`pts` is added to `base` when a pick falls in that bucket; the total is
clamped to 0-100 and mapped through the same letter bands as the real grade
(A+ >= 85, A >= 72, B >= 58, C >= 44, D >= 28, F below), so 'projected B' and
'actual B' are directly comparable in the calibration table.
Retuning is safe: projections are stamped at capture and never recomputed,
so old predictions stay as they were and calibration stays a real test.
Env var GEX_CHANGE_TOP_PROJ_RULE takes the same JSON and wins over this file.
note: example only - not fitted on anything
